regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation (9 of 22 themes eligible, 41% breadth) led by AI Compute & Optics with a thin 0.023 margin over Gold Miners, but the backtest verdict is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape) and cross-sectional rank-IC is weak — so this is a display-only leadership lens, not a return forecast. Given the track record is unimpressive (hit rate 0.41, dir accuracy 0.33, n=46) and crowding is uniformly absent except in a few rank-6+ names, I am leaning LOW conviction and producing few theses, mostly around relative attention where supported by durability/breadth, not momentum rank.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners (rank 2, score 1.86, durability 0.93, breadth 1.0, trend) as a potential leadership challenger to AI Compute & Optics — the rotation margin is only 0.023. The watch retires when Gold Miners either closes the score gap decisively (moving to rank 1 with a margin above 0.10) or falls back below rank 3 on a sustained basis.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the only eligible, scorable theme combining genuine trend health (hurst_tag 'trend'), high durability_bar (0.80), and broad participation (breadth 0.923) without being crowded (crowding_z -0.16). Its rank-5 momentum score is moderate rather than extreme, which sits better with a mean-reverting market history where chasing the top rank is punished. The lean is a relative-participation view, not a return forecast: broad, durable trend-state among eligible names is a reasonable place to express a tactical overweight.
theses.dissent: China industrial metals demand is tightly tied to property/construction and export tariffs; a fresh macro/policy shock (property credit squeeze or US tariff escalation) could unwind the trend state quickly, and the mean-reverting tape means the trend gate may whipsaw.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the rank-1 leader but shows poor trend health (hurst_tag 'mean-revert'), the lowest durability_bar among the top four (0.45), and weak breadth (0.235) — a thin, concentrated leadership at the top of a mean-reverting tape. Given gate_helps=false on this market, the absolute-trend gate offers no drawdown protection here, so the combination of high rank + mean-revert texture + low breadth argues for standing aside rather than adding. This is an avoidance of a fragile leader, not a fade or short.
